prompt_text: Best donor CRM with online giving built in
response_text:
The strongest “all‑in‑one” donor CRMs with **online giving built in** that consistently review well are **Bloomerang**, **Funraise**, **Keela**, **Donorbox**, **Giveffect**, and **Aplos**.[1][2][3][4][6][7][8][9]

Below is a concise comparison focused specifically on donor CRM + native online giving (forms/pages, recurring, receipts, basic automation).

| Platform | What it is | Online giving built in? | Best fit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Bloomerang** | Full **donor CRM** with fundraising, email, and marketing tools.[6] | Yes – **online giving pages, forms, and unified “giving platform”** features are built into the CRM.[6] | Small–mid nonprofits wanting a modern donor database + strong fundraising and retention tools in one system. |
| **Funraise** | **Nonprofit CRM and donor management software** with a native fundraising suite.[7] | Yes – donation pages, forms, recurring giving, peer‑to‑peer, and events are part of the platform and tie back to the CRM.[7] | Campaign‑heavy orgs (online fundraising, P2P, events) that still need a central donor CRM. |
| **Keela** | **Nonprofit CRM** built around fundraising and communications.[1][3] | Yes – customizable branded **online donation forms** with payment processing (e.g., Stripe) feeding directly into donor records.[1] | Orgs that prioritize donor communications, segmentation, and automated stewardship alongside online giving basics. |
| **Donorbox** | Primarily an **online giving platform** with a growing **CRM** layer.[1][4] | Yes – donation forms, recurring giving, text‑to‑give, etc., all sync into an integrated **Donorbox CRM**.[1][4] | Nonprofits that want strong online giving first and a simpler CRM (without a complex database to set up). |
| **Giveffect** | All‑in‑one **nonprofit CRM + fundraising + automation** platform.[2][9] | Yes – includes online giving forms and donation tracking within the CRM environment.[2] | Mid‑size+ orgs wanting website giving, campaigns, and CRM in a single, more enterprise‑style stack. |
| **Aplos** | Accounting‑first platform with **built‑in nonprofit CRM and donor management**.[1] | Yes – online giving, text‑to‑give, recurring gifts, automatic receipts, all syncing into the CRM.[1] | Orgs that want accounting + donor CRM + online giving tightly integrated (churches and small nonprofits especially). |

### How to choose among them

If you share your situation (e.g., annual revenue, number of contacts, current tools, and budget), I can narrow this to 2–3 best options and suggest a migration path. As a quick guide:

- **Simplest setup / strong online giving first:** Donorbox or Keela.[1][3][4]  
- **Most full‑featured donor CRM with built‑in giving:** Bloomerang, Funraise, or Giveffect.[2][6][7][9]  
- **Need accounting + CRM + giving together:** Aplos.[1]
